verdict.rationale: Luma's own materials describe reference-driven generation: image-to-video and video-to-video with character reference, Modify Video V2 for restyling existing footage, motion and camera-move transfer from a source video "to new subjects, scenes, or styles," and style references carried into every asset. That covers the core of pointing at a reference image or video and getting new footage in that style. missing for 10: in-depth docs on how a style reference conditions new video generation (as distinct from modifying the source clip), and independent or hands-on evidence of style-reference results.
